title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Ms. Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati on 30.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 29/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 30.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 29/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 30.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Ms. Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati would not be available
for Judicial work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mrs. Justice M.K.Thakker)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Vaibhavi D.
Nanavati.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
